induction' h with
| refl =>
  have h_refl : r a b := AddConGen.Rel.refl h
  exact hr a b h_refl
| add h1 h2 =>
  have h1' : AddConGen.Rel r (star a) (star b) :=
    by apply AddConGen.Rel.add (star a) (star b) h1 h2
  have h2' : AddConGen.Rel r (star a) (star b) :=
    by apply AddConGen.Rel.add (star a) (star b) h1 h2
  exact AddConGen.Rel.add (star a) (star b) h1' h2'
| star h =>
  have h' : AddConGen.Rel r a b := AddConGen.Rel.star h
  exact AddConGen.Rel.star (star a) (star b) h'
